Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer misinterpreted the search results and extracted incorrect geographic information. Instead of identifying Tysons Galleria in Fairfax County, Virginia, the agent mistakenly associated it with McLean County, Illinois. This error arose from failing to critically evaluate the relevance of the retrieved search results, which included irrelevant information about McLean County in Illinois. The visible content prominently mentioned McLean County, but this was unrelated to the actual location of Tysons Galleria in Virginia. WebSurfer did not validate this finding with additional authoritative sources or cross-checks, leading to the propagation of incorrect information.
